title: Things start to stick
text: The house is starting to fill up, slowly and then all at once. A picture goes on the wall, slightly crooked, and you agree to call that character. A shelf gets its first row of books, which you have both read in part. In the evenings you sit on the floor with cups of tea and argue cheerfully about where things belong. Then one evening a small parcel waits on the doorstep, with no name on it. Nobody remembers ordering anything. Both of you are sure the other one did, and neither of you minds.
